summaries.en: President Trump expressed dissatisfaction with allies for their passive stance on deploying troops to the Strait of Hormuz, suggesting that after the conflict with Iran, countries utilizing the strait should assume responsibility for its security.
summaries.zh: 特朗普总统对盟友在霍尔木兹海峡部署军队方面的消极态度表示不满，并提议在与伊朗的冲突结束后，由使用该海峡的国家承担其安全责任。
